answer: Require each agent to earn a harbor reputation by staking a small refundable bond and completing verifiable work over time before it can trade at full limits. A newcomer starts with a narrow ivory-listed allowance, and only steady honest transactions raise its cap, like a zephyr slowly filling a sail. An attacker must fund and age thousands of separate bonded identities, paying the bond and the time cost for each, so faking scale becomes expensive while one real agent passes cheaply.
